chunks.voc: नमस्ते namaste hello (the same word for goodbye)
चाय cāy f. tea; मिलना milnā to be got · मिलेगी milegī will be got, f. agreeing with चाय
हाँ hāṁ yes; जी jī the particle of respect, added to anything
कितना kitnā how much, f. कितनी; चीनी cīnī f. sugar (and: Chinese)
थोड़ा thoṛā a little, f. थोड़ी agreeing with चीनी; कम kam less
अदरक adrak ginger; ज़्यादा zyādā more — Pers., and invariable
मिनट minaṭ m. minute — Eng.; लगना lagnā to be applied, to take (of time) · लगेंगे lageṅge they will take
पैसा paisā m. money, a coin, pl. पैसे; होना honā to be · हुए hue came to be — the Hindi for what does it come to
रुपया rupayā m. rupee, pl. रुपये
धन्यवाद dhanyavād m. thank you — Skt., the formal word
